title: Omwoyo Ogusooka Okuyimirira
intro: Edda ennyo ng’omubaka yenna tannatambula ku nsi, ng’ekyawandiikibwa kyonna tekinnabikkulwa, ekitonde ekitali kifaanana kirala kyonna kyabaawo. Omwoyo guno gwabumbibwa emikono egy’obwakatonda, ne guweebwa ekifo eky’obulungi obutafaanana, era ne gugezesebwa mu ngeri egenda okuwulikika mu byafaayo by’omuntu byonna. Ekyaddirira kyali mboozi ya bunafu, okwenenya mu bwesimbu, n’enkomerero eyandikyusizza ekkubo ly’obutonzi emirembe gyonna. Osobola okuteebereza ono ani?
clues: Nabumbibwa emikono gy’Omusaasizi ennyo okuva mu nfuufu yennyini ey’ettaka
Nnaweebwa amaka ag’obulungi obutafaanana, nga tewali njala wadde obukoowu buyinza kunkwatako
Nalagirwa obutasemberera muti gumu, kubanga gwali gugaaniddwa
Nze ne munnange twalimbibwa ne tusemberera omuti ogwagaanibwa, nga tumenya ekiragiro kya Mukama waffe
Twaddayo eri Mukama waffe n’okwenenya okw’amazima, ne tusonyiyibwa okusobya kwaffe
Mu ffe, obuntu bwonna bwava; Nze asoose nnyo okutambulira ku nsi eno

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yasindikibwa wansi ku nsi ng’omulabirira w’obuntu eyasooka
Falaawo n’eggye lye babbira mu nnyanja
Omuliro gwafuuka nnyogovu era nga gwa mirembe
Yaweebwa obuyinza ku bwakabaka bwa Misiri
outcome.answer: Yasindikibwa wansi ku nsi ng’omulabirira w’obuntu eyasooka

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
